blurb: Guests take a 75-minute boat tour on the Perseverance, a shallow-draft vessel, to see gray seals swimming along the shore and lounging on beaches. The tour includes visits to scenic harbors in Harwich Port and Chatham, with views of yachts, sailboats, fishing boats, and a lighthouse. A trained naturalist narrates the tour, providing information about wildlife and local history.

quotes.text: This was a great tour! We saw a ton of seals. The captain and tour guide were fabulous! It was easy to get to and there was a lot of parking available. I would definitely recommend!
I would highly recommend this excursion! Purchase your tickets a day in advance. The boat captain and guide were knowledgeable about the communities off the water and wildlife.
Amazing way to see Cape Cod. Interactive and relaxing cruise showcasing the seals that call our shores "home". Friendly and accommodating crew.
Great trip! Saw a lot! The tour was beautiful. We saw lots of seals. The crew was fantastic- throwing in some fun facts about the area.
Best tour on the cape, we saw a ton of Grey Seals. They took us in to a couple harbors also. A real nice ride and tour of the area.
